description: Twelve pooled calls produced 48 recorded queries and did not verify a January public protest apart from the unresolved QMMH/Tšepong source-only lead. This is not evidence that no event occurred. Searches covered weekly windows, broad English/Sesotho terms, local/regional outlets, labor, education, health, students, transport, prices and episode boundaries. Four intermediate pooled outputs have incomplete preserved URL sets and one batch’s exact query text was not retained; both limits are labeled in the query log.
required_followup: Continue with local-language/archive and other accessible source-universe searches when available; retain the open-web coverage limitation and no-absence inference.

description: The QMMH/Tšepong nursing salary-grievance action has a material onset conflict. The official DDPR report dated Mar 8 says the continuing strike started “sometime in January,” but labels the matter an “alleged” strike and supplies no exact date, public-assembly evidence or crowd count. Sunday Express, SABC, Netcare and the U.S. State Department report date the nursing action to Feb 1; an Africa-Press/Informative Newspaper retrospective says Feb 2. The National Assembly’s Mar 16 order paper later refers to a QMMH “go-slow protest currently taking place” but does not resolve the January onset. The Jan 27 deadline and Jan 18 management notice are not by themselves protest activity.
required_followup: Coordinator should inspect DDPR report pages 6–8 and compare with contemporary Jan/Feb reporting and relevant February unit. Seek evidence of public action and a January crowd; keep start date null until same episode versus distinct workplace action is resolved.
